record.hypothesis: Use unit-L2-normalized nonpadding item embeddings consistently for both sequence inputs and candidate lookup, retaining the existing sqrt(hidden_units) input multiplier and dot-product scoring. Keep padding exactly zero and retain tied embeddings and dimension 64. This may reduce frequency-driven embedding-norm disparities and improve directional discrimination. Change only embedding normalization, with identical behavior in training and the generated predictor; preserve HSTU topology, history policy, loss and optimizer.

+class UnitNormItemEmbedding(nn.Embedding):

category_rationales.rationale: Normalize nonpadding item embeddings to unit L2 norm for sequence inputs and all target/candidate lookups, reducing embedding-norm disparities while preserving tied embeddings, dimension, input scaling, dot-product scoring, HSTU topology, loss and optimizer.
